title: Sengoku Youko
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a war-torn Japan where humans and supernatural katawara live in tension, Tama, a fox-spirit katawara who loves humans, travels with her adoptive brother Jinka, a human who hates humans. They confront katawara hunters and violent warlords, joined by the cowardly swordsman Shinsuke who wants to become strong. They uncover monks experimenting on spiritually gifted people to make human-katawara hybrids and rescue one of the victims, Shakugan.
life_message: Strength is worth seeking when it protects others, and peace between peoples is possible for those who refuse to hate a whole kind.
